[name="Pith"]你们的确准备了许多，但可惜应对源石技艺的手段还是捉襟见肘。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1300_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[name="Mantra"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_008")]
[name="袭击者"]不、不对，不该是你们——
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Subtitle(text="“嘘，连你的心脏都已经沉默了。”", x=300, y=350, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]

[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown2",volume=0.5)]
[charslot(slot = "m",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "0,-60",duration = 0.5)]
[charslot(duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]

[Delay(time=1)]
[name="Touch"]伤员我来处理，不过月见夜又变得过于亢奋了。
[name="Touch"]梓兰，又得辛苦你了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_278_orchid_1#1")]
[name="梓兰"]我会处理好他的。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_095")]
[name="Pith"]博士猜得对，有人泄露了我们行动的消息。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1300_1#1$1")]
[name="Mantra"]快速解决吧，尽快将这艘备用开采舰拖动到最近的移动城市修补能源舱室。
[name="Mantra"]然后迅速赶回本舰，避免所有意外。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_281_popka_1#10$2")]
[name="泡普卡"]Pith女、女士，为什么来增援的是你们？
[name="泡普卡"]之前PRTS通知的是Misery先生呀……
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_095")]
[CameraEffect(effect="Grayscale", fadetime=0, keep=true, initamount=0, amount=0.7, block=true)]
[Background(image="bg_rhodescom",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[playMusic(intro="$ponder_intro",key="$ponder_loop", volume=0.6)]
[name="Pith"]直觉？
[name="Pith"]临出发前突然更改计划，我担心……
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "m", focus="n")]
[Decision(options="我信任你们。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[Decision(options="Misery，Stormeye，Sharp他们另有安排。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]

[name="Pith"]需要同步到PRTS上告知同事吗？
